sdgs.title: No Poverty
sdgs.description: End poverty in all its forms everywhere.

targets.description: Eradicate extreme poverty for all people everywhere.
Reduce at least by half the proportion of people living in poverty.
Implement nationally appropriate social protection systems and measures (4Ps, social pensions).
Ensure all men and women have equal rights to economic resources, basic services, and ownership of property.

sdgs.title: Zero Hunger
sdgs.description: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition, and promote sustainable agriculture.

targets.description: End hunger and ensure access by all people to safe, nutritious and sufficient food all year round.
End all forms of malnutrition, including addressing the nutritional needs of adolescent girls and children.

sdgs.title: Good Health and Well-Being
sdgs.description: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages.

targets.description: Achieve universal health coverage, including financial risk protection and access to quality healthcare services.
Substantially reduce the number of deaths and illnesses from hazardous chemicals and air, water and soil pollution.

sdgs.title: Quality Education
sdgs.description: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.

targets.description: Ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education.
Ensure equal access for all women and men to affordable and quality technical, vocational and tertiary education.

sdgs.title: Gender Equality
sdgs.description: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls.

targets.description: Ensure women's full and effective participation and equal opportunities for leadership at all levels of decision-making.

sdgs.title: Clean Water and Sanitation
sdgs.description: Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all.

targets.description: Achieve universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water for all.
Achieve access to adequate and equitable sanitation and hygiene for all and end open defecation.

sdgs.title: Affordable and Clean Energy
sdgs.description: Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all.

targets.description: Ensure universal access to affordable, reliable and modern energy services.

sdgs.title: Decent Work and Economic Growth
sdgs.description: Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work.

targets.description: Achieve full and productive employment and decent work for all women and men.
Substantially reduce the proportion of youth not in employment, education or training (NEET).
Take immediate and effective measures to eradicate forced labour and child labor.

sdgs.title: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure
sdgs.description: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation.

targets.description: Develop quality, reliable, sustainable and resilient infrastructure.
Significantly increase access to information and communications technology.

sdgs.title: Reduced Inequalities
sdgs.description: Reduce inequality within and among countries and sub-national territories.

targets.description: Empower and promote the social, economic and political inclusion of all, irrespective of age, sex, disability.

sdgs.title: Sustainable Cities and Communities
sdgs.description: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.

targets.description: Ensure access for all to adequate, safe and affordable housing and basic services and upgrade slums.
Provide access to safe, affordable, accessible and sustainable transport systems for all.
Significantly reduce the number of deaths and the number of people affected by disasters.
Reduce the adverse per capita environmental impact of cities, including municipal waste management.

sdgs.title: Responsible Consumption and Production
sdgs.description: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns.

targets.description: Substantially reduce waste generation through prevention, reduction, recycling and reuse.

sdgs.title: Climate Action
sdgs.description: Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts.

targets.description: Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters.
Improve education, awareness-raising and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation and adaptation.

sdgs.title: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
sdgs.description: Promote peaceful and inclusive societies, provide access to justice and build effective, accountable institutions.

targets.description: Significantly reduce all forms of violence and related death rates everywhere.
Develop effective, accountable and transparent institutions at all levels.

sdgs.title: Partnerships for the Goals
sdgs.description: Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.

targets.description: Fully operationalize the technology bank and science, technology and innovation capacity-building mechanism.
